tldr: Staff hide a variant in one channel. The channel listing keeps its prices, and customers cannot see or buy the variant there.
goal: Staff need to hide a variant in one channel without deleting its listing and prices.

story.heading: Catalog stores a per-channel availability flag
story.body: The listing stores is_available_for_purchase per channel. An unavailable listing counts as absent for customers.

story.heading: Catalog API adds a channel availability mutation
story.body: Staff set a variant's availability per channel by ID or SKU. The listing update accepts the flag too.

story.heading: GraphQL API adds an availability error type
story.body: The new mutation returns ProductVariantChannelListingAvailabilityUpdateError with the failing channel IDs.

story.heading: Listing table gets an availability column
story.body: The new column is_available_for_purchase is a boolean. Its default value is available.

story.heading: A hidden variant stays in its channel listing
story.body: Staff hide a variant in one channel. Its prices and listing stay stored, and customers cannot buy it there.

components.summary: Adds a mutation that sets a variant's availability per channel by ID or SKU.
Adds the availability error type that the new mutation returns.
Stores the per-channel flag and treats unavailable listings as absent for customers.
Reads the channel flag when it fetches, prices and checks checkout lines.
Skips promotions for listings that are unavailable in the channel.

decisions.title: Keep the flag on the channel listing
decisions.why: A hidden variant keeps its prices and its listing in that channel.

decisions.title: Default a new listing to available
decisions.why: A listing created without the flag stays purchasable, so existing clients keep working.

decisions.title: Add a separate availability mutation
decisions.why: Staff change availability without resending prices, and the mutation accepts a variant ID or SKU.

flows.title: Update a variant's availability in a channel
